issues.description: Syllable-to-note lyric alignment is not transcribed (lyricsAlignmentVerified=false).
Underlines are reproduced as printed; their exact musical meaning (slur/tie) is not interpreted for playback.
Dynamics/accents printed in the scan (mf, ff, dim., >) are not encoded.

notationConventions.raw: Tonic sol-fa as printed: ':' separates beats, '.' halves a beat, '—' holds the previous note.
notationConventions.playbackInterpretation: Durations computed from the printed beat structure.

transcriptionStatus.notes: 3/4 confirmed by the printed bars (3 beats each; 1-beat pick-up + 2-beat final bar). startBeat values are absolute (bar n starts at (n-1)*3; the pick-up sits on beat 3 of bar 1).

noteRegeneration.source: displayRaw (as edited by the user, unchanged)
noteRegeneration.method: token-based SATB note rebuild; each : or | is a rhythmic-cell boundary; MIDI pitches mapped from do and octave marks; rhythmic dots and holds interpreted
noteRegeneration.timeBase: absolute (full-bar source coordinates, corrected for pickups by app timing module)
noteRegeneration.attention: 3/4/4/4/6/8 meters and fine dotted/subdivided figures were interpreted from existing JSON; the printed score may require further manual timing validation.
